items: 5 scholarships every Indian student should know
scenes.say: Want to study abroad for free? Here are five scholarships every Indian student should know.

items: Need 2,800 hours (about 2 years) of work experience
scenes.say: One. Chevening, in the UK. A one year master's with tuition, travel, visa and a monthly allowance. You need about two years of work experience. Applications usually open in August.

items: Degree with 55% + 3 years of work experience
scenes.say: Two. Fulbright Nehru master's fellowships, in the USA. Up to two years, covering tuition, living costs and air travel. You need fifty five percent in your degree and three years of work experience.

items: Government of India · 125 awards a year
For SC and other listed categories
Family income up to ₹8 lakh · age under 35 · 60% marks
Tuition + living allowance for master's or PhD
scenes.say: Three. The National Overseas Scholarship from the Government of India, for S C and other listed categories. Family income up to eight lakh rupees, age under thirty five, and sixty percent marks. It pays tuition and a living allowance.

items: Master's in 2 or more European countries
Apply to each programme, usually October to January
scenes.say: Four. Erasmus Mundus, in Europe. Study one master's in two or more countries, with travel, visa and a living allowance. Apply directly to each programme, usually from October to January.

items: Public universities: low or no tuition
DAAD scholarships for master's and PhD
scenes.say: Five. D A A D, in Germany. Most public universities charge low or no tuition, and D A A D scholarships help with master's and P h D study.
Official links are in the description. Find the full list free on Marg Disha dot com.
